cards.card_text: Now he turns to something heavy: the wrath of God is being revealed from heaven against all the godlessness and wickedness of men.
cards.verse_text: The wrath of God is being revealed from heaven against all the godlessness and wickedness of men who suppress the truth by their wickedness.
cards.snippet: The wrath of God is being revealed from heaven against all the godlessness and wickedness of men who suppress the truth by their wickedness.

cards.card_text: Paul backs it up with the prophet Isaiah (Isaiah 59:20-21; 27:9): 'The Deliverer will come from Zion; He will remove godlessness from Jacob.' That's Jacob, also called Israel (Genesis 32:28).
cards.verse_text: And so all Israel will be saved, as it is written: “The Deliverer will come from Zion; He will remove godlessness from Jacob.
cards.snippet: …it is written: “The Deliverer will come from Zion; He will remove godlessness from Jacob.
